name: ShopTrueProfit
summary: Profit reports for Etsy, eBay and Amazon sellers: upload your sales reports and see profit per order, product and month after fees and ads, processed in the browser.
best_for: Etsy sellers, and smaller eBay or Amazon sellers, who want to see profit per order and product after fees and ads, and prefer to keep their report files in the browser instead of connecting a store login
skip_if: your main store runs on Shopify or WooCommerce, you want a live connection to your marketplace account, or you want a product we have tested ourselves instead of one read from its public pages
honest_knock: eBay and Amazon support is labelled beta and cloud sync covers Etsy data only. Free shows only your latest month, so a real history needs a paid plan. The page shows dollar signs without a currency code, and the lifetime offer has no stated end date. It is not the Shopify product TrueProfit.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Monthly · Monthly $7 a month with cancel anytime
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on shoptrueprofit.com, dollar amounts as shown) ShopTrueProfit has three options. Free costs $0 and gives a full sample-data demo, your latest month, the Etsy, eBay and Amazon fee calculators, and files that stay in your browser. Monthly costs $7 a month and adds your full profit history, month, year-to-date, yearly and custom date ranges, comparison against the previous period, profit per order, product and month, ads return on spend, cloud sync and backup for Etsy data, and CSV exports; the page says you can cancel anytime. The Lifetime founding member offer is $59 one time, shown next to a struck-through $99, and includes everything in Monthly, all future updates and no subscription; the page says the discount is applied at checkout. Payments, receipts and sales tax are handled by Lemon Squeezy, and you get a license key by email. The page shows dollar signs without naming the currency. We did not buy a plan, so we do not know the tax added, when the founding price ends or what a refund looks like.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session tested ShopTrueProfit as a web tool in the session that we were already signed in to, using only the built-in sample data of a fictional Etsy shop: one click gave a profit dashboard (net profit $506.61 on net sales of $2,171.00) in about a minute. The prices match the dossier. No own CSV files were uploaded, so how the tool reads real exports, Cloud Sync, export, checkout and the claim that files are never uploaded were not tested. Account and start: ShopTrueProfit is not a Shopify app but a web tool without an install, where Etsy, eBay and Amazon CSV files are dropped in. We were already signed in (the top bar showed an account mail address, which is covered in the pictures); no account was made in this test, no Shopify route exists and no store was used. The test started at 08:58 in our own tab on the home page. The page title says Etsy, eBay & Amazon profit in 60 seconds. The home page says Files never uploaded and No store login, and has the buttons Choose CSV files and Try with sample data. Core action: no own Etsy CSV files were uploaded, because no real shop data was available and the file format could not be made up without real exports. One click on Try with sample data gave the dashboard within a few seconds, about 1 minute and 1 click to the first result. It is labelled SAMPLE DATA (fictional shop) not saved. Overview: Net sales $2,171.00 (40 orders, 58 items), Etsy fees $850.19 (39.2% of sales), Product costs $814.20 (all orders costed) and Net profit $506.61 (margin 23.3%). Ads ROI: Etsy Ads spend $146.20, Offsite Ads fees $50.10, Sales per $1 of ads $11.06. The fees tab splits the fees into Shipping labels $420.10, Etsy Ads $146.20, Transaction fees (6.5%) $141.17, Payment processing $79.62, Offsite Ads $50.10 and Listing fees $13.00, which add up to the $850.19. The sample numbers are internally consistent (net sales minus fees minus product costs gives the net profit), but they say nothing about how the tool reads real exports, because only the built-in data was used. Product costs: the tab says per unit: materials + packaging + POD and Type a cost and press Enter. Saved in this browser (and in your account if Cloud Sync is on). The demo came with costs already filled in ($26.25, $6, $11, $8.75 on the first four listings); nothing was changed. The tabs are Overview, Orders, Listings, Fees and Product costs. Plans, read up to the payment step: Free $0 (Full sample-data demo, Your latest month, Etsy, eBay & Amazon fee calculators, Files stay in your browser), Monthly $7 /month (Everything in Free, full history, date ranges, comparison with the previous period, profit per order, product and month plus ads return on spend, Cloud sync and backup for Etsy data, CSV exports, Cancel anytime) and Lifetime $59 one time with $99 crossed out, Founding member price and Discount applied at checkout. The page says that payments, receipts and sales tax are handled by Lemon Squeezy and that you get a license key by email after buying. The prices match the dossier (Free $0, Monthly $7, Lifetime $59 with $99 crossed out); there is no deviation. The account menu shows Activate Pro and the window says No synced Pro history yet for this email; no key was entered. Checkout: NOT reached. The buttons Get Monthly and Get Lifetime were not clicked, so no tax, total, license key mail or payment screen was seen. Cancelling: not tested because nothing was bought; the site says Cancel anytime and a window points to the Lemon Squeezy receipt email for it; the account was not deleted. Not tested: own Etsy, eBay or Amazon CSV files, the eBay and Amazon beta, Cloud Sync, CSV export, the checkout and Lemon Squeezy, and whether the promise Files never uploaded is true (the network traffic was not measured). So the claims about local processing, cloud sync and exports are not tested here. Clean up: nothing was installed, no test products were made, nothing was bought; the tab was closed. The sample data is not saved by the tool.
exit_test.awkward: Only the sample data was tried, so the numbers show how the dashboard looks but not how it reads real Etsy exports. The costs in the demo are filled in already, so the effort of entering product costs for a real shop was not seen. The claim that files are never uploaded could not be checked.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.

not_tested: Own Etsy, eBay and Amazon CSV files and the eBay and Amazon beta.
Whether files are never uploaded (the network was not measured).
Checkout, Lemon Squeezy, a license key and cancelling.

Session and source-reading date: 18 November 2026. Times are CET. The session started at about 08:58 CET. These are approximate tester observations, not benchmark timings. Midnight timestamps are required date anchors, not measured event times.
exit_test.note: A check of this export route with synthetic records, on the account and date stated. Re-importing the export was not tested. The exported file was not opened, so what it contains is unverified. Friction is described, not scored; this is not a verdict on the product.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session tested ShopTrueProfit as a web tool in the session that we were already signed in to, using only the built-in sample data of a fictional Etsy shop: one click gave a profit dashboard (net profit $506.61 on net sales of $2,171.00) in about a minute. The prices match the dossier. No own CSV files were uploaded, so how the tool reads real exports, Cloud Sync, export, checkout and the claim that files are never uploaded were not tested. Account and start: ShopTrueProfit is not a Shopify app but a web tool without an install, where Etsy, eBay and Amazon CSV files are dropped in. We were already signed in (the top bar showed an account mail address, which is covered in the pictures); no account was made in this test, no Shopify route exists and no store was used. The test started at 08:58 in our own tab on the home page. The page title says Etsy, eBay & Amazon profit in 60 seconds. The home page says Files never uploaded and No store login, and has the buttons Choose CSV files and Try with sample data. Core action: no own Etsy CSV files were uploaded, because no real shop data was available and the file format could not be made up without real exports. One click on Try with sample data gave the dashboard within a few seconds, about 1 minute and 1 click to the first result. It is labelled SAMPLE DATA (fictional shop) not saved. Overview: Net sales $2,171.00 (40 orders, 58 items), Etsy fees $850.19 (39.2% of sales), Product costs $814.20 (all orders costed) and Net profit $506.61 (margin 23.3%). Ads ROI: Etsy Ads spend $146.20, Offsite Ads fees $50.10, Sales per $1 of ads $11.06. The fees tab splits the fees into Shipping labels $420.10, Etsy Ads $146.20, Transaction fees (6.5%) $141.17, Payment processing $79.62, Offsite Ads $50.10 and Listing fees $13.00, which add up to the $850.19. The sample numbers are internally consistent (net sales minus fees minus product costs gives the net profit), but they say nothing about how the tool reads real exports, because only the built-in data was used. Product costs: the tab says per unit: materials + packaging + POD and Type a cost and press Enter. Saved in this browser (and in your account if Cloud Sync is on). The demo came with costs already filled in ($26.25, $6, $11, $8.75 on the first four listings); nothing was changed. The tabs are Overview, Orders, Listings, Fees and Product costs. Plans, read up to the payment step: Free $0 (Full sample-data demo, Your latest month, Etsy, eBay & Amazon fee calculators, Files stay in your browser), Monthly $7 /month (Everything in Free, full history, date ranges, comparison with the previous period, profit per order, product and month plus ads return on spend, Cloud sync and backup for Etsy data, CSV exports, Cancel anytime) and Lifetime $59 one time with $99 crossed out, Founding member price and Discount applied at checkout. The page says that payments, receipts and sales tax are handled by Lemon Squeezy and that you get a license key by email after buying. The prices match the dossier (Free $0, Monthly $7, Lifetime $59 with $99 crossed out); there is no deviation. The account menu shows Activate Pro and the window says No synced Pro history yet for this email; no key was entered. Checkout: NOT reached. The buttons Get Monthly and Get Lifetime were not clicked, so no tax, total, license key mail or payment screen was seen. Cancelling: not tested because nothing was bought; the site says Cancel anytime and a window points to the Lemon Squeezy receipt email for it; the account was not deleted. Not tested: own Etsy, eBay or Amazon CSV files, the eBay and Amazon beta, Cloud Sync, CSV export, the checkout and Lemon Squeezy, and whether the promise Files never uploaded is true (the network traffic was not measured). So the claims about local processing, cloud sync and exports are not tested here. Clean up: nothing was installed, no test products were made, nothing was bought; the tab was closed. The sample data is not saved by the tool.
exit_test.awkward: Only the sample data was tried, so the numbers show how the dashboard looks but not how it reads real Etsy exports. The costs in the demo are filled in already, so the effort of entering product costs for a real shop was not seen. The claim that files are never uploaded could not be checked.
